Initial release of cxm-neural-memory skill.

- Enables semantic search across codebases using natural language queries.
- Provides dependency graph mapping to assess "blast radius" before refactoring.
- Supports ingestion of code and non-code (documentation/config) files into memory for richer architectural context.

- Includes a recommended workflow for safe and effective complex refactoring.
